referenceImages.name: Fondukistan monastic annex
referenceImages.scope: Estimated historical monastic cells, meeting hall and common rooms adjoining the distinct sanctuary. Written room functions are archaeological facts; dimensions, eight-cell census, sections and south-side layout are original reconstruction estimates.
